instruction.text: Jordan has come up with a new recipe for his drink: The Sour Explosion. Sort the percentages from largest to smallest.
What is the main ingredient in Jordan’s drink?
Mrs Berg asked all her pupils what their favourite colour is. Sort the percentages from largest to smallest.
What is the most popular colour in Mrs Berg’s class?
Mrs Berg also asked her pupils what their favourite team sport is. Sort the percentages from largest to smallest.
What sport is the most popular in Mrs Berg’s class?
